name: Hugging Face Skills
summary: Agent Skills for AI/ML work on the Hugging Face Hub: dataset creation, model training, evaluation and core hf CLI operations.
description: Skills follow the standardized Agent Skills format. The recommended starting point is the `hf-cli` skill, which teaches an agent the `hf` commands (search models, manage datasets and buckets, launch Spaces, run jobs); further workflow skills install with `hf skills add <skill-name>`.
